newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunker fuel steady, quiet.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunker fuel steady, quiet.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were steady in quiet trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
"There's not much going on, just a few bits and pieces," a Rotterdam dealer said. He put 380 cst at $83 a tonne and 180 cst at $88, with Antwerp prices $1 higher.
Hamburg was also quiet, with 380 cst at $89/90 and 180 cst at $95/96.
Fos prices were little changed but one dealer said enquiry was strong, especially for 380 cst, with many complaining of shortages.
Prices in most other Mediterranean centres eased, with Piraeus at $91 for 380 cst and $98 for 180 cst.
